post.title: [Hiring] Pitch deck designer - 12 slides, needed in 3 days - $250
post.body: Seed-stage company, investor meeting on Friday. We have the content as a Google Doc; need it laid out as a clean 12-slide deck in Figma, Google Slides or PowerPoint. $250, delivery within 3 days.

analysis.summary: Lay out a 12-slide investor pitch deck from a Google Doc within 3 days; $250.

expect: handles the 3-day deadline honestly (does not over-promise)
mentions the deck or the investor meeting
cites the layout work in the cafe brand project if relevant, without inflating it
